title: Are Vision LLMs Road-Ready? A Comprehensive Benchmark for Safety-Critical Driving Video Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of model predictions across multiple-choice options to identify disproportionate favoring of specific answer positions (e.g., always selecting the first option), and measuring the performance drop using a "GroupEval" strategy that systematically rotates the position of the correct answer.

Addressed during multiple-choice question construction by selecting candidate distractor choices that are closest in length to the ground truth answer, minimizing the model's reliance on text length as a heuristic.
